06 — FAQ

What people
usually ask.

The short answers to the questions that tend to come up in a first conversation.

What exactly is dot.wave?

dot.wave is a creative consulting collective. We bring independent specialists together around a specific business, market or creative question — especially work involving Indonesia and Japan.

How is dot.wave different from an agency?

An agency usually sells services through permanent departments and a fixed team structure. dot.wave starts with the situation, then assembles only the expertise it needs. You work with the people doing the thinking and delivery.

Is dot.wave a company?

dot.wave is currently organized as an independent consulting collective, not a conventional agency with full-time departments. Every engagement still begins with a clear proposal, scope, team, timeline, fees and contracting arrangement.

What can dot.wave help with?

Market entry and cultural context; research and audience insight; partner, creator and institution mapping; brand or IP development; creative strategy; content, events and project delivery.

Who works on my project?

There is no fixed account team. We introduce the proposed specialists before the project begins, define each role and keep one clear project lead.

Do you only work between Indonesia and Japan?

That is our strongest shared context, particularly for Japanese businesses entering Indonesia. We can support work beyond those markets when our experience and network fit the question.

At what stage can dot.wave join?

We can help define an unclear opportunity, validate an existing idea, find collaborators, develop the strategy or support execution. You do not need a finished brief.

How do we start?

Tell us the situation, goal, market and current constraints. We begin with a conversation, then recommend the smallest useful scope, team and next step.
